interpretationRules: Generated does not mean reviewed; reviewed does not mean accepted.
Missing action, partial contextual reuse and unsuitable candidate are distinct.
Idle upward-attention/viewer-glance subposes do not cover every body heading and gaze direction.
Mirror is not an independent generated drawing or verified anatomical/occlusion use.
Source recoverability and PR storage are independent from artistic/contact/loop acceptance.
Normal-yard playback requires exact served build plus ordinary species/action triggering evidence; preview/demo gallery is insufficient.
Source/model claims are limited to recorded provenance; no downloaded Cornell photo conditioning.
